verdict.rationale: `ultrametric init` writes skill files into the project, and the docs say those files can be committed to share the setup with the team. A hands-on dry run confirmed it previews SKILL.md targets for both Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills). Missing for 10: team sharing is documented in a single line with no guidance on maintaining or updating shared skills, the hands-on probe covered only the dry run (not an actual write and commit), the skill set is limited to Ultrametric's own skill, and there is no independent corroboration. [2026-10-14 re-judge parity audit (owner-product lane): full 7 -> partial 5, the standard both audits set: the owner's only distribution path is committing generated skill files, with no team tooling and no recorded teammate pickup — below gstack's dedicated team tooling at partial 5, while the arena's fulls (8-9) stand on marketplace or registry distribution. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
